verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Open WebUI connects to many providers (Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs) and lets users switch models by hand mid-conversation. Nothing documents automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits. Python Functions/Pipes are only developer building blocks someone could use to build such logic, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a self-hoster, model failover keeps the assistant working — automatic fallback to another provider or model when one errors or rate-limits
